baseline_models.mechanism: جعل as production, singular منه as source, and الزوجين resolved by the apposition الذكر والأنثى form a one-to-two differentiation: one origin is made into opposed yet mutually paired sexed counterparts.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something into being supplies the productive act that yields the pair.
Paired counterparts supply the relational unity of the two outputs.
Male in contrast to female specifies one member of the created pair.
Female in contrast to male specifies the other member of the created pair.

changed_reading.before: A source simply yields a male and a female.
changed_reading.after: The clause foregrounds a single productive act that differentiates one origin into a complete paired contrast, male and female.

baseline_models.mechanism: The state-making branch of جعل and the kind-or-variety branch of زوج allow الزوجين to classify the product into two sex kinds. The dual need not mean one married couple; male and female can be the two resulting classes.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies transformation into differentiated conditions.
Kind or variety makes the dual a two-class taxonomy rather than necessarily a spouse-pair.
The male category names the first class.
The female category names the second class.

changed_reading.after: الزوجين can denote the two created kinds, individually male or female, so its pairing is taxonomic before it is marital.

baseline_models.mechanism: The joining and spouse branches of زوج keep a relational reading beside the taxonomic one: the two sexes are not merely isolated labels but are constituted as counterparts capable of reproductive and social coupling.

activation_trace.role: Pairing or joining supplies an active relation between the two sexed outputs.
The spouse image supplies the specifically social and reproductive possibility of the pairing.
Male names one reciprocal endpoint.
Female names the other reciprocal endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two independent sex classes.
changed_reading.after: The verse also presents each sex as a counterpart whose relational pairing enables further generation and social attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence moves from a clear drop and emitted reproductive fluid to attached gestation, creation, and completed proportioning. فجعل then reads as the next dependent operation: sex differentiation emerges within an ordered developmental process rather than as an isolated instantaneous split.

activation_trace.role: State-making anchors the focus as a transformation within a sequence.
The two kinds are the differentiated developmental result.
A clear fluid ranging down to a drop, including semen, supplies the small material beginning.
Semen from which formation is determined specifies the reproductive source carried into the focus pronoun.
Pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies attachment as an intermediate developmental condition.
Bringing the creature into existence supplies bodily formation before sex differentiation.
Integrity and completion in the formed thing supplies the immediately prior completed bodily state.

structural_cues: 75:37-39 uses a ثم ... فخلق فسوى ... فجعل progression, while منه links the focus result back to the prior reproductive material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fluid, semen, attachment, creation, proportioning, and then فجعل; I infer developmental dependency from that ordered syntax. A live alternative is that فجعل summarizes divine classification without marking a separate biological stage.

changed_reading.before: One source is immediately split into male and female.
changed_reading.after: Sexed difference is the culminating differentiation of a staged passage from reproductive fluid through attachment, formation, and proportioning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by challenging denial that dispersed hard bones can be gathered and closes by asking whether the capable maker can restore life to the dead. The focus's production of a fully differentiated pair from minute prior material becomes the concrete middle premise: demonstrated first creation warrants reassembly and revival.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being anchors the demonstrated creative operation used by the argument.
A complete paired output displays differentiated rather than merely undirected production.
Joining what is dispersed into one whole supplies the denied resurrection operation.
Hard bone supplies the resistant bodily matter whose recovery is questioned.
Original creative bringing-into-being supplies the precedent immediately before the focus.
Effective capability reaching action makes the initial operation evidence for the final one.
Animate life supplies the state to which the dead are to be returned.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal condition the closing question says can be reversed.

structural_cues: The challenge about gathering bones in 75:3-4 and the question about enlivening the dead in 75:40 bracket the origin sequence ending at 75:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denied reassembly, an observed first formation, effective capability, and the final life-from-death question; I supply the analogical arrow from demonstrated origination to possible revival. The alternative is that 75:39 is only one item in a cumulative proof rather than its central middle premise.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports the origin of the two sexes.
changed_reading.after: The origin of the two sexes functions as evidence: power that produced organized difference from slight material can also gather bodily remains and restore animate life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question whether the human supposes he will be left as-is is answered by reproductive material whose branch network includes determination and by formation whose branch network includes measuring. جعل into two kinds therefore reads as purposive apportionment, not accidental residue.

activation_trace.role: Deliberately turning the source into a state anchors directed allocation.
Two kinds supply the ordered categories into which the source is apportioned.
Supposition supplies the mistaken premise that the following formation sequence overturns.
Leaving a thing on its existing state supplies the negated alternative to directed transformation.
Determining a thing and carrying its decree supplies measured direction within the reproductive source.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies design before the two-kind result.

structural_cues: The rhetorical question of 75:36 is immediately answered by the origin sequence of 75:37-39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated abandonment, determination, measured formation, and state-making into two kinds; I infer that sex differentiation exemplifies purposeful ordering. A live alternative is that the sequence proves capacity without asserting a separate teleological claim about each sex outcome.

changed_reading.before: Male and female are two outcomes of formation.
changed_reading.after: Their differentiation is presented as a measured allocation that directly contradicts the idea that the human is left without directed formation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated generic الإنسان is challenged at the beginning and end of the surah, while the self itself is its own witness. Naming both male and female at the focus distributes that generic human across the complete sex pair, closing an escape route by category: bodily origin, death, and accountability encompass both.

activation_trace.role: The two counterparts supply an exhaustive paired scope for the generic human.
Male instantiates one half of the human scope.
Female instantiates the other half of the human scope.
The visible human category supplies the generic denier at the opening challenge.
The repeated visible human category returns immediately before the origin proof.
The thing in its very identity supplies personal, non-transferable witness and accountability.

structural_cues: الإنسان recurs in 75:3, 5, 10, 13, 14, and 36; 75:39 replaces the generic singular with the explicitly exhaustive male/female pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated generic الإنسان, personal self-witness, and the named sex pair; I infer distributive coverage of every human instance. The alternative is that male/female serves only as a biological sign of power, without independently marking the addressee's scope.

changed_reading.before: The male/female detail concerns reproduction in general.
changed_reading.after: The detail universalizes the surah's human subject: neither sex lies outside created dependence, bodily return, or personal accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole surah repeatedly sets contrasted alternatives beside one another: immediate/later, radiant/scowling faces, truth-confirmation/denial, and life/death. The kind and counterpart branches of زوج make male/female the final embodied instance of this pair-forming rhetoric, showing capacity to constitute discriminated alternatives without assigning either sex the moral value of another pair.

activation_trace.role: Similar or opposite counterparts supply the focus's explicit paired form.
Kind or variety lets the pair instantiate differentiated classes rather than a moral ranking.
Speed and precedence supply the preferred immediate pole.
What comes after the first supplies the abandoned later pole.
Beauty and radiance supply one visible facial outcome.
A scowling face under severe aversion supplies the contrasting facial outcome.
Truthfulness supplies the affirmed response that the denier failed to enact.
The opposite of truth supplies the chosen contrasting response.
Animate life supplies one terminal state in the closing contrast.
Loss of life supplies the other terminal state that capability can reverse.

structural_cues: The surah builds adjacent contrasts at 75:20-24, 75:31-32, and 75:40 before and after naming الزوجين in 75:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated lexical and visual antitheses plus زوج as counterpart and kind; I infer that recurrence primes the focus as an instance of a surah-wide pairing architecture. The live alternative is ordinary local contrast with no architectonic force, and no moral pair should be mapped onto male versus female.

changed_reading.before: Male/female is an isolated biological binary.
changed_reading.after: Male/female is also the final concrete instance of the surah's repeated formation of contrasted pairs, without correlating sex with the good/bad poles of judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denier first returns proudly to his أهل, then the closing origin sequence names male and female as paired counterparts. The family group in which he feels belonging is thus retrospectively grounded in the very pair-making act used to challenge his denial.

activation_trace.role: The spouse branch supplies the marital relation from which a household can grow.
Pairing and joining supplies the operation that makes the two sexes relational.
A group of closeness and belonging supplies the denier's socially secure destination.
Forming family through marriage links that group directly to spouse-pairing.

structural_cues: The proud return to أهل in 75:33 stands only a few ayat before the male/female pair in 75:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kin-group belonging, family formation through marriage, and male/female pairing; I infer retrospective irony: the denier's household security depends on the maker he denies. The alternative is that أهل is merely his current family and carries no causal link to 75:39.

changed_reading.before: The focus names biological sexes without a social horizon.
changed_reading.after: The created pairing also grounds household belonging, making the denier's return to his family an unwitting dependence on the creative act he rejects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, scattered matter is gathered, life reaches separation, limbs wrap together, and the person is driven onward. Against those operations, منه ... الزوجين is not a static taxonomy but another controlled transition between unity and plurality: one source is differentiated into a coordinated two.

activation_trace.role: State transformation anchors the focus as an operation rather than a static label.
Paired counterparts supply coordinated plurality emerging from the one source.
Joining dispersed pieces into one supplies the inverse cohesion operation.
Separation and dispersal into parts supplies the death-side movement away from cohesion.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies bodily recombination at the crisis of death.
Driving toward a destination supplies directional control over the resulting embodied person.

structural_cues: The surah moves from gathering bones to separation at death and final driving, while the focus moves grammatically from singular منه to dual الزوجين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, separation, wrapping, driving, and the singular-to-dual focus construction; I infer a shared transformation grammar under one agency. A live alternative is that these are independent bodily scenes and only the resurrection analogy, not a general cohesion/difference model, is active.

changed_reading.before: The focus fixes two biological categories.
changed_reading.after: The focus displays controlled differentiation, one phase in a wider command of bodily cohesion, separation, recombination, and destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects a textile side branch of سدى and the material wrapping image of التفّت to the focus's counterpart pair. It remains anchored in جعل as ordered state-making and زوج as paired composition, but downstream prose should present it only as a material resonance, never as the translation of سدى or الزوجين.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَجَعَلَ ... ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ, read after أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى and وَٱلْتَفَّتِ

activation_trace.role: State-making supplies the ordering action applied to the paired result.
Paired counterparts supply two coordinated elements in the material analogy.
The warp of a cloth supplies the image of longitudinal material awaiting composition.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the closing material operation at death.

changed_reading.before: The human is not abandoned aimlessly and is then made male or female.
changed_reading.after: At the level of exploratory material analogy, loose warp is not left uncomposed: paired elements are ordered into embodied form, which is finally wrapped at death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The forceful-male and soft-yielding-female branches are branch-distant and could be misused as essentialist claims. They remain formally anchored to the two focus nouns and are checked by the immediately prior equality and completion branches of سوى; downstream prose must label this a lexical-material polarity, not a moral hierarchy or a claim about individual men and women.

activation_trace.role: Hardness, sharpness, and force supply one material-quality pole attached to the male root.
Softness and yielding supply the contrasting material-quality pole attached to the female root.
Equality or equivalence between two contains the polarity within coordinated formation.
Integrity and completion prevent the two qualities from being read as complete versus defective.

changed_reading.before: Male and female name sex only.
changed_reading.after: The branch network briefly evokes hard/forceful and soft/yielding material poles, but prior taswiya holds both within one completed, coordinated creation rather than ranking them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because the female root's fertile-land branch meets the closing root of life through rain and vegetation. It remains anchored to الأنثى and the focus's act of bringing into being, but downstream prose should call it an ecological echo linking generation and revival, not a direct sense of الأنثى or an exclusive equation of women with fertility.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَجَعَلَ ... ٱلْأُنثَىٰ immediately before أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ

activation_trace.role: Bringing into being anchors the generation side of the ecological analogy.
Easy fertile land with quick abundant growth supplies the cross-domain germination image.
Earth coming alive through rain and vegetation links growth from ground to revival after death.

changed_reading.before: The female term is only the second anatomical sex label.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory branch echo, fertile ground and vegetative revival let sexual generation point beyond itself toward the closing possibility of life emerging after lifelessness.

strongest_changes: The immediate 75:37-39 sequence turns a static male/female split into the culminating differentiation of fluid, attachment, creation, and proportioning.
The opening challenge about gathered bones and the closing life-from-death question turn first sexed creation into an analogical warrant for resurrection.
Repeated whole-surah contrasts activate الزوجين as both two created kinds and one instance of a broader pair-forming structure, without moralizing either sex.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet placed the singular-to-dual focus clause inside repeated movements of pairing, gathering, separating, and restoring. It also exposed contained material echoes of warp, hard/soft qualities, and fertile ground that a conservative reading would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact grammatical reach of منه remains open between the immediately preceding reproductive material and the already formed human.
الزوجين may foreground counterpart relation, two kinds, or a latent spouse relation; the focus syntax does not force one branch to erase the others.
The surah-wide pairing and cohesion/difference models may be deliberate architecture or reader-supplied patterning beyond the local resurrection proof.
